projects.title: Saltwater Cathedral
projects.summary: A flooded gothic nave at low tide. Lighting study built around one shaft of late sun and a lot of wet stone.
projects.brief: A personal study: how much story can one shaft of light carry through a flooded nave? The goal was a single still that reads as calm first and ruined second.

process.title: Blockout
process.text: Greybox in Blender from reference photos of three coastal churches, locked to a 35mm camera before any detail went in.

process.title: Surfacing
process.text: Wet stone, algae and tide lines built as layered smart materials, driven by a height mask of the waterline.

process.title: Lighting
process.text: One sun, volumetric fog and a bounce card. Most of the time went into the balance between the light shaft and the reflections.

projects.title: Kiln
projects.summary: A ninety second short about a potter and a firing that goes wrong. Keyframe animation, cloth and ember simulation.
projects.brief: A ninety second short for Harrow & Pike about a potter whose first big firing goes wrong. The studio wanted weight and patience in the acting, not slapstick.

process.title: Layout
process.text: Rough camera and staging in Maya, cut to the scratch voice track before any keyframes.

process.title: Animation
process.text: Blocked in stepped keys, then splined in passes. Hands and clay contact were animated first, the body after.

process.title: Effects
process.text: Cloth on the apron and ember sims from the kiln door in Houdini, cached and brought back for Arnold renders.

projects.title: Orbital Nursery
projects.summary: A greenhouse ring aboard a generation ship. Modular kit, 41 unique assets and a full day to night cycle.
projects.brief: Northfold Games needed the greenhouse ring for a generation ship: modular, readable at gameplay distance and able to carry a full day to night cycle.

process.title: Kit design
process.text: A modular kit of 41 pieces on a 2m grid, designed so every seam lands on a structural rib.

process.title: Dressing
process.text: Scanned plants from Megascans mixed with hand-built hydroponic racks to keep the silhouette sci-fi.

process.title: Day cycle
process.text: Lighting keyed at six times of day, with the ring shadow sweeping the floor as the station turns.

projects.title: Paper Tigers
projects.summary: Folded paper characters for a 15 second broadcast spot. Stylised rigs, stop-motion timing and hand-painted textures.
projects.brief: A 15 second broadcast spot for Lumeo. Everything had to look folded from one sheet of paper and move with a stop-motion rhythm.

process.title: Rigs
process.text: Stylised rigs that bend only along fold lines, so no pose ever breaks the paper illusion.

process.title: Timing
process.text: Animated on twos with held frames, then a small random jitter on every hold to feel hand-shot.

projects.title: Low Tide Motel
projects.summary: A roadside motel between two storms, built as a single hero shot. Neon, rain and a vending machine that still works.
projects.brief: A roadside motel caught between two storms, built as a single hero shot to practise wet surfaces and neon in real time.

process.title: Shot first
process.text: Composed the final frame before modelling, then built only what the camera sees.

process.title: Rain
process.text: Layered rain: particles near camera, animated normal maps on the tarmac, and a drip mask on every overhang.

_schema.shape: optional. sphere | torus | shard | cube | capsule | octahedron | cone | knot | cylinder (default sphere)
_schema.finish: optional. satin | metal | iridescent | glossy (default satin)
_schema.worldModel: optional. path to a small .glb shown in the void instead of the shape (built by 3d/build_models.py). The shape stays as the fallback while it loads or if it fails.
_schema.accent: optional. colour of the object once rendered, and the accent on its project page
_schema.type: short label shown on hover, e.g. Environment / 2026
_schema.role: optional. what the artist did on the project
_schema.hero: optional. main image at the top of the project page (falls back to breakdown.final, then cover)
_schema.breakdown: optional. { wireframe, clay, lighting, final } image paths of the SAME shot; any two or more show the section
_schema.model: optional. path to a .glb for the 3D turntable
_schema.video: optional. { url, poster, title }. url can be YouTube, Vimeo or a local .mp4/.webm
_schema.gallery: optional. [{ src, alt, layout: full | half }]
_schema.brief: optional. text (string or array of paragraphs)
_schema.process: optional. [{ title, text }] or a string
_schema.heroAlt: optional. alt text for the hero image
_schema.modelAlt: optional. description of the 3D model for screen readers
_schema.gallery[].alt: describe each still for screen readers
_schema.artist.skills: [{ name, level }] shown as render settings
_schema.artist.phone: optional. shown as a tap-to-call link under the email
_schema.artist.heroModels: optional. [{ name, src, wire }] real models for the hero (made with tools/optimize-model.mjs). Empty or missing = the abstract knot.
